items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt list; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.why: Activated to 53; facility access earlier noted; backups poor (Lloyd/Johnson low EPA).
items.implication: Jacobs reclaims lead role; limits handcuff upside. Workload questions post-layoff per some analysts.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs due to layoff workload uncertainty.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Monday Night vs Dallas.
items.implication: A.J. Brown and Goedert see elevated targets/routes; Eagles pass game funnels more.
items.opportunity: Higher target share for AJ Brown and Dallas Goedert.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; official downgrade confirmed by team/insiders.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgraded; Huntley start limits ceiling for Flowers/Andrews/Likely.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) QUESTIONABLE; McVay: felt loss of power/explosion, will test pregame. Minor but GTD.
items.why: Calf issue mid-week practice; limited/no Friday; pregame test.
items.implication: If OUT, heavy TE funnel (37% TS historically); Higbee lead option.
items.opportunity: Tyler Higbee primary; Parkinson/Atwell elevated if inactive.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel OUT for 49ers vs Falcons (Achilles/ribs and hamstring).
items.why: Coach Shanahan confirm Evans; official outs list.
items.implication: Massive funnel to Kittle and CMC (slot temptation); Christian Kirk debut possible.
items.opportunity: Kittle high routes/targets; CMC more receiving snaps/routes.

items.text: Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play Monday vs Dallas after full Saturday practice; DeVonta OUT confirmed.
items.why: Returned to practice (full Sat); hamstring progress; efficient prior games; Dallas soft vs RBs.
items.implication: Start if active; elite matchup. Berry loves if playing.
items.opportunity: Full workload expected vs weak Dallas run D.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) QUESTIONABLE after limited practices; key DFS/slate swing vs Miami.
items.why: Returned limited after multi-week absence; 50/50 feel.
items.implication: If active, start vs soft Miami; Berry starts if plays. Else handcuffs elevate.
items.conflict: Stephania Bell more cautious on immediate return.

items.text: Key OUTs: Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson.
items.why: Official Sunday injury dump; corroborated by Schefter full outs list.
items.implication: Role expansions for backups/handcuffs and pass-catchers in those offenses.
items.opportunity: Walker full with Charbonnet out; Gibbs more without Monty; Higbee/Worthy/Godwin/Irving elevates; IND TE vacuum.

items.text: If Puka OUT, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell etc. (Adams already long-term out).
items.why: Historical 37% TE TS without Puka; Adams multi-week hamstring.
items.implication: Higbee preferred short-term TE stream; stash Ferguson.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike; Higbee lead.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT creates sweet setup for Bijan Robinson vs 49ers D (inflates opp RB by 4.4%, recent RB catches high). Bijan full workload + DvP.
items.why: 49ers recent RB receptions (White/Holani/Harvey/Love); DvP data 7th-most inflation.
items.implication: Strong RB1 spot; smash if volume holds.
items.opportunity: Receiving work + carries vs soft D without BRob.

items.text: With 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT), Kittle goes nuts on scheme + opportunity; CMC tempted for more slot WR snaps (rare but buy given Black presence and dire situation).
items.why: Entire WR corps injured; CMC smile on slot question; scheme funnels TE.
items.implication: Kittle TE1 smash; CMC receiving upside spike.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Kittle; CMC slot snaps/routes.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown (97% routes/33% TS buy despite drops; vs CHI) and Colston Loveland (30% TS/19.2 PPR since Caleb return, 6+ rec both games).
items.why: AJB usage elite; Loveland production spike with Caleb; Bears/Lions soft spots.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving (workloads + soft matchups). Hates Josh Jacobs (layoff), Rome Odunze, Josh Downs, Travis Kelce (matchups/roles).
items.why: Volume + matchup for loves; Jacobs ramp/role risk, nasty Ds/low share for hates. Also loves Kraft vs DET.
items.implication: Start Warren/Hubbard/Irving; fade listed hates. Saquon/Breece loves if active.
items.opportunity: Confirmed high snaps/carries for loved RBs.
items.conflict: Jacobs activation conflicts with hate (still workload risk).

items.text: Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on only 68.8% routes; Kmet IR reduces 2/3-WR sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: YPRR data + Kmet season-ending IR quote.
items.implication: Higher route/target share upside with Caleb.
